name: vsdxeditor
description: Browser-based viewer, editor, and visual differ for Visio .vsdx (and .vsd) drawings, with a deterministic git diff/merge toolchain for .vsdx files.

scripts.test: npm run test:vsdx-diff && npm run test:diff-view
scripts.vsdx:install-difftool: git config diff.vsdx.textconv 'node scripts/vsdx-serialize.mjs textconv' && git config diff.vsdx.binary true && git config merge.vsdx.name 'deterministic vsdx 3-way merge' && git config merge.vsdx.driver 'node scripts/vsdx-serialize.mjs merge %O %A %B %P' && echo 'git vsdx diff + merge drivers configured'

author: Smart Nexia
